description.en: Remembers which challenge NPC started the match (its index in the challenge table), for CMND_GET_ENCCHR_INDEX after the match. The challenge NPCs of a map (the characters that start a match when talked to) are kept in a table of the script system, by index; the challenge script ie4_ev_sub_enc.nut uses these commands.

examples.case: Before the match (real usage, from ie4_ev_sub_enc.nut)
